sources.source_identity: 介護保険最新情報Vol.1332 / 老高発1129第1号・老認発1129第1号・老老発1129第1号 / 2024-11-29

fingerprint_payload.summary: 2024-11-29 notice abolishes the 2021-03-19 predecessor notice on the same date.
Standardizes accident reporting to support collection, analysis, reuse, and electronic reporting.
As a rule, report deaths and accidents requiring medical diagnosis with treatment; other accidents follow local handling.
Use the attached standard form where possible and include its items even when a local form is used.
As a rule, reporting is by electromagnetic means such as email.
Initial report should cover at least form items 1-6 and be submitted promptly, with five days as the latest guide.

The form targets care-insurance facilities, dementia group homes including preventive, specific facilities including community/preventive, and listed elderly housing/facility types; other home/community services are encouraged to use it where possible.
Accident status / severity and death date.
Provider/facility overview including service type and provider number.
Person information and care/cognitive status.
Accident overview: time, place, type, details, special notes.
Response at occurrence: response, consultation, diagnosis and treatment outline.
Post-accident status, family reports, contacted organizations, follow-up plans.
Cause analysis.
Recurrence-prevention measures and evaluation.
Other notable matters.

fingerprint_payload.summary: The embedded revision history records v1.00 (2024-11-18), v1.10 (2025-02-03), and v1.20 (2025-03-13); v1.10 added section 1.4 and v1.20 records additional operational changes.
Section 1.4 states that the database-system service names may aggregate multiple long-term-care insurance service names.
Section 1.4 directly maps reporting-system service codes across home, day, facility, community-based, preventive, and equipment-related service groupings, including conditional grouping notes.
Section 1.4 explicitly marks 居宅療養管理指導 (310), 養護老人ホーム variants (33C/36C), 介護予防支援 (460), 介護療養型医療施設 (530), and the listed comprehensive-project rows A20/A60/A90/AF0 as outside the reporting target.
